name: @w6w-apps/calendly
description: Read Calendly users, event types, scheduled events and invitees; create single-use scheduling links and manage webhook subscriptions.

w6w.longDescription:
Calendly manages who's meeting whom and when. This app reads users, event types, scheduled events and their invitees, generates single-use scheduling links a workflow can hand out, and manages webhook subscriptions so Calendly can notify a workflow when something books or cancels.

Every object is addressed by Calendly's own absolute identifier, and actions that take a single object accept either that identifier or the bare id, so results from one call feed directly into the next without extra parsing. Reading the current user or looking up a specific scheduled event and its invitees covers the common case of finding out who booked what and when, without opening the Calendly dashboard.

A good fit for workflows built around booking events — creating a one-off scheduling link for a specific request, reacting to a new booking through a webhook, or pulling invitee details into a CRM or support ticket the moment someone schedules time.
